approval.rationale: Top-down rounded field-stone cobbles about 20 cm across, set in loose rows in packed mud and grit; with the revised layout (0.26 m cells) every stone stays one stone, where candidate 45501 turned into gravel. It reads as the rough cobbled street of a borderland town.
limitations: The stones sit apart in wide mud joints rather than tightly packed, closer to a cobbled yard than a dressed town street.
The stones are similar in size and tone; there are no setts, kerbs, gutters or worn wheel ruts.
Each stone carries a baked top-light highlight; from the low landscape camera they read slightly domed and lit from above.
